Chapter 1098: 24 The Seventh Physical Body Divine Ability (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1098: Chapter 24 The Seventh Physical Body Divine Ability (Seeking Subscription)_2

Whether it was initially acquiring this Star Fragment World or trading with the master of Wanqu, Lin Yuan gained considerable advantages, undoubtedly due to Ancient Ming Venerable’s covert nods.

…

Outside the Star Fragment World.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and several other Supremes were quite at a loss.

Just now, the ruler of Chaos Continent, Chaos Venerable Ancient Ming, personally came, seeking to pay respects to Lin Yuan.

Pay respects?

To Lin Yuan?

The term ‘pay respects’ is generally used by those of lower status seeking an audience with someone of higher status, or at least someone of equal stature.

But Ancient Ming Venerable?

Even though the Xuanyuan Supreme and a few other Supremes had prior knowledge of Lin Yuan’s power being tantamount to the Chaos Realm, they merely viewed him as a newly ascended figure in the Chaos Realm.

Yet Ancient Ming Venerable is an experienced Chaos Realm figure. Given his status, even if he wished to meet Lin Yuan, would it truly be in such a manner of ‘paying respects’?

Therefore, the Xuanyuan Supreme, Xia Qin Supreme, and other Supremes were somewhat anxious.

Strictly speaking, the human civilization currently resides in the Star Fragment World, which is a part of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, encompassing the entire human civilization, including their nine Supremes.

All must depend on the goodwill of Ancient Ming Venerable.

Quickly.

The Xuanyuan Supreme received Lin Yuan’s response.

“The Galaxy allows you to enter.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme suppressed his inner shock and cautiously spoke to Ancient Ming Venerable.

“Alright.”

Ancient Ming Venerable nodded, without any discomfort.

Upon entering the Star Fragment World, Ancient Ming Venerable arrived at the grand hall designed to receive guests of human civilization.

Buzz.

A figure materialized—it was Lin Yuan.

At this moment, only Lin Yuan and Ancient Ming Venerable remained in the hall. As for the Xuanyuan Supreme? He had long since retreated.

Though the Xuanyuan Supreme couldn’t comprehend why Ancient Ming Venerable acted this way, he knew full well that a venerable coming in person must have important matters to discuss with Lin Yuan.

“Greetings, Senior.”

Ancient Ming Venerable immediately bowed slightly towards Lin Yuan.

It is extremely difficult for a Chaos Great Saint to completely kill a Chaos Venerable, but no Chaos Venerable would act presumptuously before a Great Saint with this in mind.

Under normal circumstances, a venerable facing a Great Saint must show enough reverence.

Unless the two are in a life-and-death conflict, with hatred that cannot be resolved, only then would a Chaos Venerable dare to disregard norms.

But such situations are rare.

And now, in Ancient Ming Venerable’s eyes, Lin Yuan is a Great Saint.

With no grievances between them, Ancient Ming Venerable, wishing to befriend Lin Yuan, certainly dared not overstep.

“Senior?” Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged, immediately realizing that Ancient Ming Venerable might have misunderstood something.

“Does he think I’m the reincarnation of a Great Saint?” Lin Yuan pondered rapidly, realizing what Ancient Ming Venerable likely thought.

The matter of a Great Saint’s reincarnation has been mentioned both by the Profound Xuanhuang line and the Magic Jade Tower.

Before his hometown universe faced great destruction, Lin Yuan learned from the mouths of two ultimate members of the Robber Clan that they believed him to be a reincarnation of a Great Saint.

However, the Robber Clan attributed this belief to his terrifying growth trajectory within the universe.

Lin Yuan ascended from an evolver to dominate the universe in just a few millennia.

But why would Ancient Ming Venerable also assume him to be the reincarnation of a Great Saint?

“How did you recognize me?” Lin Yuan asked casually.

Upon hearing this.

Ancient Ming Venerable immediately responded, “Senior, I have a partner, a marvelous lifeform, with flowing…

Ancient Ming Venerable thoroughly explained the matter of the Chaos Dragon Beast’s ‘premonition’.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan felt enlightened, meanwhile raising his view even more towards those marvelous lifeforms with flowing time bloodlines.

This ability to foresee, simply defies logic.

“The Moyu Tower Master, along with several others of the peerless Great Saints, paid a heavy price to hunt a Great Saint-level, time bloodline-rich marvelous lifeform…”

Lin Yuan deeply appreciated the high stakes involved in such a hunt.

At the Chaos Great Saint level, marvelous lifeforms in terms of combat power might compare to peerless Great Saints, but hunting them? It’s infinitely harder than killing a peerless Great Saint.

Given their ability to foresee and anticipate, how could one possibly kill them?

…

“I came to pay respects to the senior because I’m here to congratulate the senior on restoring to the Chaos Realm…”

Ancient Ming Venerable immediately voiced his purpose, simultaneously flipping his hand to produce a jade bottle, “This is a congratulatory gift.”

Given it’s a congratulatory visit, Ancient Ming Venerable naturally wouldn’t come empty-handed, surely needing to offer a gift as a sign of sincerity.

Especially now, with no other venerables knowing Lin Yuan’s true identity apart from him, Ancient Ming Venerable understood even better the need to seize this opportunity.

Befriending a Great Saint reincarnation before they regain peak strength, awaiting this Great Saint’s return to the Great Saint Realm, even if one asks for nothing in return.

Once word spreads, would other Chaos Venerables dare to provoke him?

“Hmm.”

Lin Yuan accepted the jade bottle, not showing any humility.

Now, having just stepped into the dominator realm, all accumulated resources have been entirely consumed, how could he possibly refuse the offered resources?

“In a while, I’ll reveal myself with Chaos Realm combat power, announce becoming a venerable, then can smoothly host a celebration, gather gifts.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, this is also the fastest way to amass wealth, far quicker than plundering.

At the celebration of a newly ascended venerable, surrounding forces in the Void Domain would likely participate, and participation surely entails congratulatory gifts.

This was something Lin Yuan did many times in his hometown universe, each time ending with great profits.

“Senior, now that you have restored your Chaos Realm strength, are you planning to establish a Chaos Continent?” Ancient Ming Venerable tentatively inquired.
